result.title: FourSight: Stable FP4 RL Post-Training via Sequence Filtering and Sparse Channel Compensation
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training increasingly targets low-bit deployment, with NVFP4 weight-and activation quantization (W4A4) becoming the state-of-the-practice format. However, integrating NVFP4 into RL degrades rollout quality and amplifies cross-engine training-inference mismatch (TIM), destabilizing training. We show that these failures are concentrated rather than uniform - severely mismatched tail tokens concentrate in a few outlier sequences, while policy weights remain largely intact and quantization error concentrates in a few high-variance activation channels. Guided by this, we present FourSight, an algorithm-system co-design with two targeted solutions: TIM-aware sequence filtering that excludes drifted trajectories from policy updates, and sparse precision compensation that keeps only top-variance channels in BF16 while retaining native NVFP4 elsewhere. We further design a fused SpliceGEMM kernel with specialized prefill and decode datapaths to minimize overhead. FourSight sustains near-BF16 accuracy and strong FP4 deployment quality across models and engines, while improving step-to-accuracy by 1.76-2.60x and staying within 2.3% of FP4 step time up to 120B-scale models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FourSight，通过序列过滤与高方差通道的 BF16 补偿，使 NVFP4 的 RL 后训练保持稳定并接近 BF16 效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦低比特量化下的数值稳定性与训练-推理解码引擎失配，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据使用或停止决策，也未提供可核查的 LVR 方法线索。
